units.source_text: 这里正是里日本的海啊！

en.t: This is precisely the Sea of the Back of Japan!

units.source_text: 是我所有的不幸和灰暗思想的源泉、我一切丑陋和力量的源泉。

en.t: It is the source of all my misfortune and gray thoughts, the source of all my ugliness and strength.
The sea was heaving with violent waves.

units.source_text: 海涛后浪推前浪地接踵而来，前浪与后浪之间可以窥见通畅的灰色深渊。

en.t: The waves came one after another, each rear wave driving the one before it, and between the waves one could glimpse an open gray abyss.

units.source_text: 昏暗的海面上空，密密层层的积云既凝重又纤细。

en.t: Above the dim surface of the sea, dense layers of cumulus clouds were both heavy and delicate.

units.source_text: 无境界的凝重的积云不断地镶嵌着无比轻盈而冰冷的羽毛般的花边，围着中央隐约可见的淡蓝的天空。

en.t: The boundless, weighty cumulus clouds kept setting in featherlike lace, incredibly light and cold, around the pale blue sky faintly visible at the center.

units.source_text: 铅色的海，又背靠着黑紫色的海角上的群山。

en.t: The leaden sea, in turn, rested against the mountains on the black-purple cape.

units.source_text: 所有的东西都有一种动摇和不动。

en.t: Everything possessed a kind of wavering and immobility.

units.source_text: 不断活动着的黑暗力量和像矿物似地凝结了的感觉。

en.t: A dark force in ceaseless motion, and a sensation congealed like a mineral.
